entry.title: New: Bill 76 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ADMINISTRATION PROGRAM, MAUI COUNTY WETLANDS" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget to update the names of the listed organizations and projects and to add an additional recipient.
